title: Private jet charter to Japan: permits and rules
description: Private flights to Japan: the Article permits for foreign aircraft and paying passengers, domestic legs and airports, from the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau.
h1: Private flights to and from Japan
lead: Every private or charter flight to Japan needs the authority's permission first. What the rules are, how far ahead to plan, and what they mean for your trip.

p: Permits are issued by the {{jp.authority}}. The basic rule: {{jp.permit}}.

A charter with paying passengers needs a second permit: {{jp.permit_paid}}. This is why the operator's presence in Japan, through an office or an agent, makes a large difference to how short the notice can be.

Flights between two Japanese airports are tightly controlled: {{jp.cabotage}}. If your trip includes a domestic leg, we check with the operator before you see a quote. Our cabotage guide explains the general rule.

Not every airport can take a foreign aircraft: {{jp.customs_airports}}. Crossing Japan without landing: {{jp.overflight}}. One more condition: {{jp.notable}}. Our Tokyo guide compares Haneda and Narita.

The operator that flies your trip applies, usually through its handling agent or a flight-permit service. You do not need to deal with the authority yourself. What you can do is give us final names, passport details and times early, because a permit is issued for a given aircraft, schedule and passenger list, and late changes can mean a new application.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Japan
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator against our safety standard before you see a quote, and ask the operator to apply for the permits early, because the authority's answer decides the schedule. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.
Permit rules change. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its official source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: How far ahead must a charter flight to Japan be arranged?
faq.a: The rule for paying passengers is: {{jp.permit_paid}}. We ask the operator to apply as soon as your plans are firm.

faq.q: Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
